description: CLI-0028: external file with several rules and -e list order

files.input.txt:
This is a red herring.	Das ist ein roter Hering.
This is a fine day.	Das ist ein schöner Tag.
Good day.	Guten Tag.
files.bt.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules targetLang="de" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../bitext.xsd" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
<category id="CAT1" name="idioms">
<rule lang="de" id="red_herring" name="Ext bitext rule">
<pattern>
	<source lang="en">
		<token>is</token>
		<token>a</token>
		<token>red</token>
		<token>herring</token>
	</source>
	<target>
		<token>ein</token>
		<token>roter</token>
		<token>Hering</token>
	</target>
</pattern>
<message>Meinten Sie <suggestion>ein Ablenkungsmanöver</suggestion>?</message>
<example type="correct"><srcExample>is a red herring</srcExample>
<trgExample>ok ok</trgExample></example>
<example type="incorrect" correction="ein Ablenkungsmanöver"><srcExample><marker>is a red herring</marker></srcExample>
<trgExample><marker>ein roter Hering</marker></trgExample></example>
</rule>
<rule lang="de" id="good_day" name="Good day"><pattern><source lang="en"><token>good</token><token>day</token></source><target><token>Guten</token><token>Tag</token></target></pattern><message>Meinten Sie <suggestion>Hallo</suggestion>?</message><example type="correct"><srcExample>Good day.</srcExample><trgExample>Hallo.</trgExample></example><example type="incorrect" correction="Hallo"><srcExample><marker>Good day</marker>.</srcExample><trgExample><marker>Guten Tag</marker>.</trgExample></example></rule></category></rules>
